question: In which year was the 86th Constitutional amendment (adding 11th fundamental duty) enacted?
solution:
The correct answer is **__2002__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• 86th constitutional amendment inserted a new article in **PART III (21A)**, ensuring the **Right to Education **as a fundamental right.
 
• This says, The State shall provide free and compulsory education to all aged **6 to 14 **years.
 
• Originally Directives Principles of State Policies of **PART IV** had a provision for state-funded education for equitable access.
